description: MedaRep's knowledge card for a procedure market, a device company, or a company within one procedure, built from its own data: the market (Medicare cases and change, the all-Medicare estimate and Medicare Advantage share, the forecast, site of care now against a few years back) and its companies (who has the widest reach, who is launching, open recalls, who gained surgeons); a company's listing, owner and deals, and per procedure its position, reach now and a year before, surgeons gained and lost, launches (novel, new brands, line extensions), recall and report signals, design program and financial capacity, the procedures the rep works first. Each with a reading and a soWhat for the rep's lines. Where MedaRep has written it, `written` adds short cited points from public sources, reviewed by a person: a company's stated strategy, products and how it sells in the procedure (its 10-K) and its open studies; a market's open trials, what recent reviews and guidelines cover, and the open debates. Attribute them when you use them. Use it for background on a company or market before a call, a competitor question or a plan. Company standings need the coverage add-on.

company.description: A company as it reports ("Stryker") or its slug.

family.description: Procedure family key from coverage (e.g. knee-arthroplasty, lumbar-fusion) or a plain name.

name: knowledge
title: What MedaRep knows about a company or market
